title: kate-text: name the other side of a bracket
summary: bracket_mate returns the closer for an opener and the opener for a closer. A letter and a quote return None. The test goes in the existing brackets tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: brackets.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Add bracket_mate. Walk PAIRS. Use one if else if. Do not nest an if inside the first if. if ch == open { return Some(close); } else if ch == close { return Some(open); } After the loop, return None. Do not touch PAIRS, matching_bracket, pair_of, scan, on_scan, or bracket_at. The test bracket_mate_names_the_other_side asserts these results. An open parenthesis returns Some close parenthesis. A close parenthesis returns Some open parenthesis. An open angle bracket returns Some close angle bracket. A close angle bracket returns Some open angle bracket. The letter a returns None. A double quote returns None. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: brackets::tests::bracket_mate_names_the_other_side
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because bracket_mate does not exist. Parentheses and angle brackets return the other side. The letter a and a double quote return None.
